patch: the floor (floor v4 and later): FL-1 and FL-16 delete the backdrop sampler, the clamp and its earned darken, the knee, --glass-backdrop-luma, backdropMode and the adaptive tint (REGISTRY P5-3.3; names per P5-5 H6-1, backdropMode from P5-3.3's row, backdrop mode and adaptive tint per P6-2.2 R-15 (ii)). The concepts a patch deletes with no identifier are declared here by hand; declare-removed.mjs adds every identifier the patch's removed lines name (R-15 (iii)). H9-1 (P8-5): the clamp's oklab tint seam, its tint arm and the dock's active-field tint legibility seam are declared as phrases; each live homonym site (the feedback-tone seam and its gate, the music-staff folio's own seam, the accent axis that OKLab-tints a rim) is a `homonyms` site entry, read in context in pass 9 (pass-9/H9.md §1)
